title: KP14 bounded exposure (cap 2.5), mirrored types \pm0.3 / 0.7 / 1.2, level ladder 0.5..2.0, \gamma_v 4.0, \sigma_\epsilon 0.3
question: Does a KP14 economy whose only type-dependence is a PRODUCT of two visible mean-zero factors (sign of b via size, eps - 1 via ROE) reach a fair gap of 0.1/yr (+0.029 monthly)?
notes:
WHY (2026-10-31). The KP14 interaction slot: vyge/vygel (positive b) had room 10-27% because b_f (eps-1) is monotone in ROE; vygesm (mirrored, |b| <= 0.15) 7-12% because the positivity bound made the product's Sharpe tiny; vygels (mirrored to 0.45) could not be solved (negative unit project values). vygelbc with the profitability noise raised from 0.2 to 0.3 (stationary sd of eps 0.24 -> 0.36): the exposure b_f (eps - 1) h'(y) widens with the eps deviation; unit values are unchanged on the eps grid (min +0.24; positive down to eps = 0 since A1/A0 < 1).

PRECOMMITMENT STATUS: precommitted=false; ids filled from the Quest build log by the solve script before any seed runs.

PREDICTION (2026-10-31): oracle room 40% or more (both factors mean zero, as in vyg25s / bvychs30) and a fair gap of +0.03 to +0.10 monthly; passes at +0.029 or more on most seeds. FALSIFIED if room is at or below vygel's 27% on three seeds.

changes: {'sigma_eps': 0.3}; own tables under prefix vygelbcs; everything else vygelbc's
